sentences.en: My parents don't like my boyfriend because of his ethnicity.
sentences.zh: 1. 我父母不喜欢我的男朋友是因为他的种族背景。

sentences.en: I have loyalty to my country, Algeria, before any ethnicity.
sentences.zh: 2. 我对阿尔及利亚这个国家的忠诚高于任何种族身份。

sentences.en: Hanfu is the traditional clothing of the Han ethnicity.
sentences.zh: 3. 汉服是汉族的传统服饰。

phrases.zh: 柏柏尔人族裔：柏柏尔人的种族身份

senses.zh: 种族特性，民族特征；种族，民族
